newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSI Services issues validated Hang Seng movements.
newsitem.headline: HSI Services issues validated Hang Seng movements.

text.p: HSI Services Ltd said the validated Hang Seng indices movements on the Hong Kong stock exchange on Thursday were as follows:

The validated closing levels for the Hang Seng Index and the Hang Seng China Enterprise Index are unadjusted from figures earlier provided by the stock exchange, while some intra-day figures and the Hang Seng MidCap 50 close have been adjusted.
A technical defect in the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong's computer system on Thursday generated inaccurate previous day closing prices, causing erroneous calculations of indices at the start of trade.
The Hang Seng Index incorrectly appeared to drop over 500 points to 12,674 at the open, and the exchange later pegged the day's low at 12,960.81.
HSI Services is an independent firm charged with calculating the Hang Seng indices based on data from the stock exchange.
